headline: Argentine FX Gap Rises to 10% Amid Suspected Central Bank Intervention
summary: Argentina's FX gap between the official and parallel dollar expanded to 10% as global market pressures and 2027 debt maturities spurred dollar hedging, while traders noted bond-market intervention to stabilize quotes.
why: Argentina maintains strict capital controls; the spread between the official and parallel peso gauges market confidence in the exchange rate band.

entities.name: Banco Central de la República Argentina

impacts.name: Argentine Blue Dollar
impacts.why: Hedging demand widened the exchange rate gap to 10% despite official interventions.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Global financial volatility and lower FX supply lifted dollar demand, widening the spread to 10% despite suspected bond-market intervention.
